items.shortDescription: The Asia region exerts significant influence globally and in Australia. Young Australians need to develop the knowledge, skills, capabilities and attitudes to effectively navigate and contribute to our regional neighbourhood. Asia is our part of the world. Knowing, understanding and growing engagement with Asia are foundational for young people as Australia seeks to strengthen its ties in the Asia region.
